correctness.rationale: The claim is finite and exhaustive. The verifier reconstructs the two child balls from the published 38-facet table, computes every induced subcomplex for all subsets of sizes one through five, computes mod-two Betti numbers from exact binary boundary-matrix ranks, checks equality for k=1..4, and checks the complete six-entry difference at k=5. It also verifies the common full f-vector, acyclicity of each ball, and an explicit boundary isomorphism. No sampling or timeout inference is used.

value.rationale: The pair is canonical precisely because it has nonisomorphic interiors behind isomorphic boundaries. Determining the least subset size at which a natural label-free induced-subcomplex fingerprint sees the difference gives a sharp local-to-global separation threshold, not an arbitrary slice. The four-vertex equality is a genuine lower bound and the five-vertex census is a complete witness; this complements the previously global distinction of the interiors.
